entities.name: UE radio capability ID
entities.description: An information element that may be included in WB-S1 mode to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.

entities.name: RACS support condition
entities.description: Condition that both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID.

entities.name: WB-S1 mode
entities.description: Property indicating the UE is operating in WB-S1 mode.

relations.description: The inclusion of UE radio capability ID IE is guarded by the condition that both UE and network support RACS and network needs to assign the ID.
The UE radio capability ID IE may be included only when the UE is in WB-S1 mode.
